lines.zh: 我摆动着触腕，在水里滑过去。
lines.en: I paddle my arms and slide through the water.

lines.zh: 身体一缩一放，就往前窜。
lines.en: Squeeze and release, and I shoot forward.

lines.zh: 我的光在水里拉出一条线。
lines.en: My glow draws a line through the water.

lines.zh: 我用后面的鳍掌握方向。
lines.en: My rear fins steer me.
I swim along the riverbed, away from light.
My arms open, then close.

lines.zh: 我张开触腕，让水推着我。
lines.en: I spread my arms and let the water push.

lines.zh: 我转了个圈，光也跟着转。
lines.en: I turn a circle and the glow turns with me.
I thread between the weeds.

lines.zh: 我沉下去一点，再升上来。
lines.en: I sink a little, then rise.

lines.zh: 我的身体透出淡青的光。
lines.en: My body gives off a pale cyan glow.
I push upstream, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的光在沙上扫出一条弧。
lines.en: My glow sweeps an arc across the sand.

lines.zh: 触腕拖在身后，像几条细绳。
lines.en: My arms trail behind like thin cords.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，因为软身子怕刮。
lines.en: I avoid the stone; soft bodies tear.
One soft jet and I drift back.
I hover in the water, rising and falling.
The glow brightens and dims.
My arms hang nearly still.
Water passes my gills with a thin sound.
Something passes; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我的光在水底照出一圈。
lines.en: My light makes a ring on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我把身体缩得小了一点。
lines.en: I draw myself a little smaller.
Water moves through my gills.
I'm soft, and very quiet.

lines.zh: 我悬着，看水草往哪边倒。
lines.en: I hover, watching which way the weeds lean.
My glow is dimming.
I brighten a little.
This water is calm enough.
I curl my arms into a loop.
I stop in the water and look at you.
My glow lands right on your face.

lines.zh: 你是活的东西里最大的一只。
lines.en: You're the biggest living thing here.
I drift up a little.

lines.zh: 触腕朝你的方向伸出去。
lines.en: My arms reach toward you.
I smell something from outside the water.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进来，光就暗了。
lines.en: Your hand enters; my glow dims.
I'm not sure what you are.
The light on my body shivers.
You stand there, watching me.
My glow flickers wildly.
I jet ink and retreat.
A cut opens in my soft body.
I curl my arms around myself.
My blood is in the water.
I sink a little.
I give a faint cry.
My glow dies; I can't tell up from down.
I can still swim.
I slip behind the weeds.
Something drifts through the water.
Is that for me, dropped in?
I approach slowly.
I reach out an arm and touch it.
This is edible.
I come a little closer.
My glow brightens.

lines.zh: 我把它卷起来，收进怀里。
lines.en: I curl it up and pull it in.
Do you have more?
I look up at you and my glow flashes.
The bump sends me drifting.

lines.zh: 我这软身子，一撞就变形。
lines.en: Soft as I am, one hit deforms me.

lines.zh: 我赶紧喷了一口水退开。
lines.en: I jet water and back off.
My arms catch on you.
It takes effort to pull free.
My glow stutters.
I turn to face you.
I don't like being bumped.

lines.zh: 我被撞得打了个旋，光也乱了。
lines.en: The hit spins me, and my light scatters.
Please walk around me.
Another of my kind glows nearby.
I answer with my light.
We circle, drawing closer.
Our arms fold together.
Our glows flash together twice.

lines.zh: 我们把卵产在水草根上。
lines.en: We lay eggs at the weed roots.
Afterward we swim apart.
This water can raise them.
I settle back to the bottom.
My glow fades by half.

lines.zh: 我用两只触腕把它兜住。
lines.en: I cradle it in two of my arms.
Soft things are easy to grip.
I bring it to my mouth.
It slips away.
I curl again.
This little thing tastes of salt.
I squeeze the water out of it.
It takes two arms to hold steady.
I can't finish it; I'll keep it.
It's stuck between my arms.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在动着靠近。
lines.en: Something moves closer through the water.

lines.zh: 我的光暗下来，藏住自己。
lines.en: I dim my glow and hide.
I raise my rear fins.
I aim at its flank.
The water shifts; it's coming.
Ink readies inside me.
I frame it between my arms.
It's too close to the water's edge.
I'll try one jet first.
It's turning toward me.
It's still coming; I don't move.
My glow flares fully.
Ink bursts and the water goes black.
It can't see; I slip around.
I swim off in another direction.
It follows slowly.
I keep to the bottom.
It's above me.
I'll wait for it to come down.
These weeds can hide me.
I jet a cloud of ink.
An arm snaps against it.
I slap with my rear fins.
I ram, then hurry back.
I catch it for a moment.
My strength is slight.
Mostly I rely on startling it.
It retreats, so I stop.
I jet again.
The water is all black now.
I light up on the riverbed.
Faint light, but enough to see.
My arms open slowly.
The water is cool. Good.
One jet and I rise.
There's none of my kind here.
I circle the riverbed.

lines.zh: 找到一块石头，我停下来。
lines.en: I find a stone and settle.
I hide in the weeds first.
Then decide whether to approach.

lines.zh: 水在沸腾，我的光都要灭了。
lines.en: The water boils and my glow nearly goes out.

lines.zh: 我被摔在水面上，软软地摊开。
lines.en: I hit the water and spread out soft.
Strange. I can't draw breath.

lines.zh: 水下传来一声闷响，我被推出去。
lines.en: A muffled blast shoves me away.
An arrow punches through me.
Light locks my arms.
I'm hungry, and my glow dims.

lines.zh: 电顺着水过来，我全身抽搐。
lines.en: The current comes through the water; I spasm.

lines.zh: 水没了，我在黑里往下掉。
lines.en: The water's gone; I fall through the dark.
